title: Intent scope split from write lease
action: Reservations declared at planning become INTENT records (advisory: warn + scheduling input, never hard-block). Hard blocks come only from exact-path write leases. reserve/paths flows classify: planning-declared broad paths/globs = intent; worker write-time = lease. Write guard consumes leases for hard denial, intents for warnings. Regen inside this cell after the code change: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write (+ impact_registry --write if suites changed). Canonical source: skills/bee-hive/templates/ (vendored to .bee/bin/ + plugin mirrors).

truths: a broad intent (src/api/*) does NOT hard-block a disjoint exact write (test)
an exact write lease still hard-blocks a conflicting write (test)
prohibitions: no hard deny from an intent record

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check

trace.outcome: Intent/lease reservation split (D4): kind field on reservation records, guard classifies broad-intent overlap as advisory (allow+warning) vs exact/lease as hard deny; cross-session holds and pathsOverlap scheduling semantics untouched.
